title: Data model — the stack-neutral semantic model
description: Written by architecture-datamodel as the editor-canvas form of model.dbml. The required keys are those the host's DataModel shape (shared/schemas/datamodel.ts) requires, so a file valid here loads in the editor; the collection's own metadata hints (tree/10_blueprint/datamodel/model.md § Format, model metadata) are optional properties. Types are semantic, never SQL or Prisma types.

editor.description: Canvas state; written by the editor, not by skills.

relationships.description: Owning side only: o2m inverses are generated by the stack translator, and an m2m needs an explicit junction entity with an m2o to both sides.

enums.description: Shared enums, referenced by a field's enum_id.

pascalValue.description: PascalCase enum value; never SCREAMING_SNAKE or lowercase.

modelName.description: PascalCase singular model name, per tree/10_blueprint/datamodel/README.md § Naming.

semanticType.description: tree/10_blueprint/datamodel/model.md § Format, scalar types, plus enum and relation. decimal is in the collection's list but not yet in the host's; slug, email and url are the host's refinements of string.

id.description: The model name: PascalCase singular (Task, ProjectMember). A feature's data_entities[] entries, relationships' from/to and a field's relation_target all use it.

glossary_id.description: Id of the glossary term this entity models: the kebab-case slug of the term (Order line → order-line). Must exist in _concept/glossary.md; the entity id is that term in PascalCase.

status.description: Present only on an entity a may_propose skill appended; the owner drops it on promotion (tree/README.md § Ownership).

proposed_by.description: Skill that appended the proposed entity.

source.description: Evidence reference or the user's words behind a proposed entity.

from_features.description: Paths to feature files that require this entity.

standard_fields.description: Fields the translator injects; they are not declared in fields. Defaults to all three.

label_field.description: Field used as display name in UI lists and dropdowns.

key_field.description: URL-friendly unique identifier field, when the entity has a readable slug.

id.description: Stable id for editor tracking (undo/redo, drag).

required.description: Required unless set false; never a ? suffix.

enum_id.description: Reference to a shared enum definition.

values.description: Inline enum: PascalCase value to description.

relation_target.description: Target entity id (model name) for relation fields.

from_field.description: Field name on the source entity; ends in _id for m2o.
